DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予防接種の予約についてですね。予約票を見ながら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about your vaccination appointment, correct? I'll ask you some questions while looking at the appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の予約を別の日にしたいです。昨日熱が出て、今日は下がりましたが、まだだるいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日の接種予約を変えたく昨日発熱し今は下がったがだるいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to move tomorrow's appointment to another day. I had a fever yesterday. It's gone down today, but I still feel tired.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change tomorrow's vaccination appointment because yesterday's fever has subsided but fatigue remains. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 体調のことは接種前に医師へ伝える必要があります。予約を変えるだけで済ませず、今の状況を確認しましょう。今は熱を測れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to tell the doctor about your condition before vaccination. Let's check how you are now rather than simply changing the booking. Have you measured your temperature?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝は三十六度八分でした。熱が下がれば明日でも受けられると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今朝三十六度八分で解熱すれば接種できると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was thirty-six point eight this morning. I thought I could get vaccinated tomorrow if the fever had gone down.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give this morning's thirty-six-point-eight temperature and explain that you thought no fever meant you could be vaccinated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 接種できるかは体温だけでは決められません。医師の確認につなぎますので、発熱が始まった時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Temperature alone doesn't determine whether you can be vaccinated. I'll refer you for a doctor's confirmation, so please also tell me when the fever began.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の昼ごろです。薬を飲んだので、その名前も伝えたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日昼ごろに発熱し飲んだ薬の名前も必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around noon yesterday. I took medicine; should I tell you its name too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the fever began around noon yesterday and ask whether the medicine's name is needed too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。薬の名前と飲んだ時刻がわかるものを用意してください。新しい日程は、体調について確認したうえで受付と調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please prepare something showing the medicine's name and when you took it. After your condition has been checked, we'll arrange a new date with reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薬の袋があります。次の予約は来週を希望していますが、先に医師への確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬袋があり来週を希望するが先に医師への確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the medicine bag. I'd prefer next week for the new booking, but please check with the doctor first.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the medicine bag and prefer next week but request the doctor's check first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。明日の予約の扱いも含めておつなぎします。今後も体調が変わったら、その内容をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll refer you, including how to handle tomorrow's appointment. If your condition changes again, please tell us what changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約票と薬の袋を手元に置いて待ちます。新しい日時は決まってから書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約票と薬袋を用意して待ち新日時決定後に書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait with my appointment slip and medicine bag ready. I'll rewrite the date and time once the new appointment is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait with the appointment slip and medicine bag and say you will rewrite the new date and time once confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、確認の担当へおつなぎします。今日は無理をなさらず、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll connect you with the staff handling the check. Please take it easy today and look after yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票が途中になっていますね。書きにくい項目を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your medical questionnaire is unfinished. Let's check the fields you're having trouble completing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この「動悸」という言葉がわかりません。走ったときに心臓が速くなることも含みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 動悸の意味を尋ね走ったときに心臓が速くなる場合も含むか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand this word ‘palpitations.’ Does it include my heart speeding up when I run?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what palpitations means and whether it includes a fast heartbeat when running. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 心臓の鼓動が気になる感じを指します。運動したときだけなのか、休んでいても感じるのかを書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It refers to feeling noticeably aware of your heartbeat. Please write whether it occurs only during exercise or also at rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここ一週間、座っているときにも胸がどきどきすることが二回ありました。今は感じていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一週間に二回座っていて胸がどきどきし今は症状がないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Over the past week, my heart pounded twice while I was sitting. I don't feel it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your heart pounded twice while sitting during the past week and you have no symptoms now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その内容を医師にもお伝えください。続いた時間や、一緒に感じた症状は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the doctor that too. Do you remember how long it lasted or any symptoms you felt with it?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時間は測っていませんが、数分だったと思います。「頻度」の欄には一週間に二回と書けばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 測定せず数分と思うことと一週間二回という記入でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I didn't time it, but I think it was a few minutes. In the ‘frequency’ field, should I write twice in one week?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the unmeasured duration seemed a few minutes and ask whether to enter twice in a week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。時間は推測とわかるように書いてください。そのときの息苦しさや胸の痛みはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Make clear that the duration is an estimate. Did you have difficulty breathing or chest pain at those times?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その二回には、息苦しさも痛みもありませんでした。診察で聞かれたら、同じように説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: その二回は息苦しさや痛みがなく診察でも説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: During those two episodes, I had neither breathlessness nor pain. I'll explain it the same way if asked during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say those two episodes involved no breathlessness or pain and you will explain that during the consultation too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 問診票にもその点を記入しましょう。途中で症状が出た場合は、順番を待たず職員に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's put that on the questionnaire too. If symptoms appear while you're here, please tell staff without waiting for your turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。今は症状がないことも書きます。診察では、原因について医師に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今は症状がないと記入し原因を医師に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll also write that I have no symptoms now. During the consultation, I'd like to ask the doctor about the cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write that you have no symptoms now and say you want to discuss the cause with the doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この問診票を診察へお持ちください。今のお話も申し送りしますので、それでは診察室でご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this questionnaire to your consultation. I'll pass on what you've said too, so please discuss it in the examination room.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 野菜の揚げ物をご覧ですか。材料で気になるものがあれば、注文前に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the fried vegetables? If any ingredients concern you, we'll discuss them before you order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: えびにアレルギーがあります。この野菜の揚げ物は、えびと同じ油で揚げていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: えびアレルギーがあり野菜の揚げ物をえびと同じ油で調理するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a shrimp allergy. Are these fried vegetables cooked in the same oil as shrimp?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your shrimp allergy and ask whether fried vegetables share cooking oil with shrimp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: えびの揚げ物にも、この鍋の油を使っています。野菜だけでも、えびの成分が混じる可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We use this pot's oil for fried shrimp too. Even vegetables alone may contain traces of shrimp.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 油を共用しているのですね。別の鍋で作ってもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共用油と理解し別の鍋で調理してもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the oil is shared. Could you cook them in a separate pot?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand that the oil is shared and ask whether cooking in another pot is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この屋台には揚げ物用の鍋が一つしかなく、別の油で調理する対応はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This stall has only one frying pot, so we cannot cook them in separate oil.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら揚げ物は頼みません。袋に入ったお菓子なら、材料表示を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 揚げ物は注文せず袋入り菓子の材料表示を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't order fried food. Could you show me the ingredient label for the packaged sweets?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline fried food and ask to see the ingredient label of bagged sweets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが未開封の商品です。原材料のほかに、製造時の注意書きもあります。表示で判断できない点は、メーカーへの確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is an unopened product. Besides the ingredients, there are manufacturing warnings. Anything unclear from the label needs to be checked with the manufacturer.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 字が小さいので、袋を手に取って読んでもよいですか。読めないまま買うのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小さい字を確認するため袋を手に取り読めないまま購入するのを避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The print is small. May I pick up the bag and read it? I'd like to avoid buying it without being able to read it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to pick up the bag to check the small print and avoid purchasing without reading it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞ。こちらの商品も、私から安全を保証することはできません。ご不安なら購入を見送ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. I cannot guarantee this product's safety either. If you're unsure, please do not purchase it.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 注意書きが十分に理解できないので、今日はどちらも買わないことにします。調理方法を教えてくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 注意書きを理解できないため両方買わず調理方法の説明に礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I don't understand the warnings well enough, so I won't buy either product today. Thank you for explaining how the food is cooked; that helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will buy neither because the warnings are unclear and thank them for explaining the cooking method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご相談いただいてよかったです。食べ物を選ぶ際には、引き続き表示をご確認ください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad you asked us. Please continue checking labels when choosing food. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お土産をお選びですか。お持ち帰りまでの時間が長ければ、保存方法もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing gifts? If it will be a long time before you take them home, please check the storage instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の夜に友人に渡します。この冷蔵のお菓子と、隣の焼き菓子で迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明日夜に友人に渡す土産として冷蔵菓子と焼き菓子を比較していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll give them to my friend tomorrow night. I'm deciding between these refrigerated sweets and the baked sweets beside them.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are comparing refrigerated and baked sweets as a gift for your friend tomorrow night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 明日まで移動されるのですね。冷蔵のお菓子には要冷蔵の表示があります。移動中も冷やせる予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you'll be traveling until tomorrow. The refrigerated sweets are labeled ‘keep refrigerated.’ Will you be able to keep them cold during travel too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宿を出てからは冷蔵庫を使えません。保冷剤だけで夜まで大丈夫とは言えませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿を出ると冷蔵庫を使えず保冷剤だけで夜まで大丈夫とは言えないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: After leaving my lodging, I can't use a refrigerator. You couldn't say an ice pack alone would keep them all right until night, could you?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you cannot use a fridge after leaving your lodging and check that ice packs alone cannot guarantee storage until night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 気温や移動時間によりますので、夜まで保冷できる保証はできません。焼き菓子の保存表示を比べてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It depends on the temperature and travel time, so we can't guarantee they'll stay cold until night. Let's compare the baked sweets' storage instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらは常温保存とありますね。期限が友人に渡す日より後か確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 常温保存の表示を読み友人へ渡す日より期限が後か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This says room-temperature storage. Could you check that the expiry date is after the day I give them to my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the room-temperature storage label and ask whether the date is after the gift day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この箱の期限は来月です。開封後の扱いは裏面に別の記載があります。箱の大きさは、お荷物に入りそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This box's date is next month. The back has separate instructions for after opening. Will the box fit in your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 大きい箱は鞄に入りません。小さい箱を二つにした場合の合計額を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大箱は鞄に入らず小箱二つの合計額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The large box won't fit in my bag. I'd like to know the total for two small boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the large box does not fit and ask the total cost for two small boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 値札は一箱八百円ですので、二箱で千六百円です。手提げ袋が必要でしたら、その料金も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The price tag says eight hundred yen each, so two are sixteen hundred yen. If you need a carrier bag, we'll check that charge too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千六百円なら予算内です。自分の袋に入れるので、小さい箱を二つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千六百円は予算内で自分の袋を使い小箱二つを購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sixteen hundred yen is within my budget. I'll use my own bag, so two small boxes, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say sixteen hundred yen is within budget and buy two small boxes using your own bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 小さい箱を二つお会計します。保存の表示はお渡し先にもお伝えください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll ring up two small boxes. Please pass the storage information to the recipient too. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お二人ともお席に着かれましたね。お料理から伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're both seated now. May I start by taking your food order?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この焼き魚は一人分ですか。二人で取り分けたいので、大きさを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 焼き魚が一人分かと大きさを聞き二人で取り分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this grilled fish one person's portion? We'd like to share it between two, so I'd like to know its size.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the grilled fish is one portion and about its size, and say two of you want to share it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一尾でお出しします。お二人で分ける方もいらっしゃいますが、食べる量によります。ご飯もお付けになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We serve one whole fish. Some people share it between two, but it depends how much you eat. Would you like rice too?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ご飯は一人ずつ頼みます。魚に小鉢が付くなら、別のつまみは減らそうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各自のご飯を希望し小鉢が付けば別のつまみを減らしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We'll each order rice. If the fish comes with a small side dish, we're thinking of ordering fewer other snacks.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request rice for each person and say you may reduce other side dishes if a small dish is included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この焼き魚は単品なので、小鉢やご飯は付いていません。定食の写真と似ていますが、こちらは別のメニューです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This grilled fish is a standalone dish, so it doesn't include a side dish or rice. It looks like the set-meal photo, but it's a different menu item.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 単品なのですね。では、焼き魚一つとご飯二つ、それにこの冷ややっこを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 焼き魚一つ、ご飯二つ、冷ややっこ一つを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it's standalone. Then one grilled fish, two servings of rice, and one of this chilled tofu, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order one grilled fish, two servings of rice, and one chilled tofu. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その組み合わせで承ります。お魚は骨付きですので、分ける際はお気をつけください。取り分け皿はお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll take that combination. The fish has bones, so please be careful when dividing it. Shall I bring sharing plates?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚ください。同行者は薬味のねぎが苦手なので、冷ややっこだけねぎを別にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取り分け皿二枚を希望しねぎが苦手な同行者のため冷ややっこのねぎ別添えを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two, please. My companion dislikes spring onion; could you put the onion separately just for the chilled tofu?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request two sharing plates and ask for spring onion on the side of the chilled tofu because your companion dislikes it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ねぎを別添えにできるか厨房に確認します。難しい場合は、冷ややっこを作る前にお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the kitchen whether we can serve the onion separately. If not, we'll tell you before preparing the tofu.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。別添えが難しければ冷ややっこはやめて、ほかの一品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別添え不可なら冷ややっこをやめて別の一品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. If serving it separately is difficult, we'll skip the chilled tofu and choose another dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will drop the chilled tofu and choose another dish if separate onion is not possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 焼き魚とご飯を先に通し、冷ややっこは確認してから伺います。どうぞお食事をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-MIYOSHI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put through the grilled fish and rice first, and ask about the chilled tofu after checking. Enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の確認ですね。どの便をご予約されていますか。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to check your reservation, correct? Which sailing have you booked?

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この予約の便です。風が強くなってきたので、予定どおり出るのか気になっています。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約を示し強くなった風で出航が心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sailing on this reservation. The wind has picked up, so I'm wondering whether it will depart as scheduled.
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show your reservation and express concern about departure because of the stronger wind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約の便を確認して、最新の運航案内をお伝えします。風だけを見て、私から出航をお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your sailing and give you the latest operating information. I can't promise departure just by looking at the wind.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 運航が決まるまで、乗り場へ進まずここで待てばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確定の間は乗り場へ進まず待つべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Until the operation is decided, should I wait here without going to the boarding area?
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether you should wait without proceeding to boarding while departure is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内があるまでは、指定された待機場所でお待ちください。荷物は手で持つ袋でしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait in the designated waiting area until instructed. Is your luggage a hand-carried bag?

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 肩掛けの袋です。カメラも持っていますが、手すりにつかまれるようにしまっておきたいです。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肩掛け袋でカメラをしまい手すりを使えるようにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a shoulder bag. I have a camera too, but I'd like to put it away so I can hold the handrail.
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a shoulder bag and will put your camera away to be able to use the handrail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両手を使えるよう整理しておくとよいですね。乗船時の持ち物の扱いと、安全用具については係員の指示を受けてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's a good idea to arrange things so both hands are free. Please follow the crew's instructions about luggage and safety equipment when boarding.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗る前に安全用具の説明を聞きます。船酔いが心配なのですが、途中で具合が悪くなったら誰に声をかけますか。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用具説明を聞き船酔い時に誰へ知らせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll listen to the safety-equipment explanation before boarding. I'm worried about seasickness; whom should I tell if I feel ill during the trip?
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will hear the equipment explanation and ask whom to notify if seasick. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 船内の係員に早めに知らせてください。無理に移動せず、その場で案内を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell a crew member aboard early. Don't try to move around unnecessarily; receive guidance where you are.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 体調が悪くなったら係員を呼びます。まず運航の案内を待って、乗るかどうか決めます。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係員へ知らせ運航案内を待って乗船を判断すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I feel ill, I'll call the crew. First I'll wait for the operating information and decide whether to board.
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the crew if unwell and decide about boarding after the operating information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 体調も考えて無理のない判断をしてください。運航案内が出るまで、それでは待機場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKS-NARUTO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consider your condition and don't push yourself. Until the operating information is announced, please wait in the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その作品の表面が気になりますか。解説のどの点をご案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in that work's surface? Which part of the explanation would you like help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠くからは写真に見えました。絵の具で描いた作品なのか、説明を読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真のように見える作品の技法を解説で確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: From a distance it looked like a photograph. I'd like to read whether it's a work made with paint.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the commentary for the technique of a work that looks photographic. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 技法はこちらの作品票に記載されています。「混合技法」という言葉はご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The technique is on this artwork label. Do you know the term ‘mixed media’?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 初めて聞きました。一種類の絵の具だけを使っているわけではないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 混合技法の意味と材料が一種類ではないかを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's my first time hearing it. Does that mean it doesn't use just one type of paint?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the meaning of mixed media and whether it involves more than one material. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 複数の材料や技法を組み合わせた表現です。この作品で使われた材料は、解説冊子でも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It combines multiple materials or techniques. Let's check the commentary booklet for the materials used in this work too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 冊子を見てから、表面の違いをもう一度眺めたいです。近づくときの線は、越えないほうがいいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冊子を読んで表面を見直し境界線を越えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: After reading the booklet, I'd like to look at the differences in the surface again. I shouldn't cross the line when approaching, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will view the surface again after reading the booklet and confirm that you will not cross the boundary line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、展示の境界線の内側には入らずにご覧ください。気になる部分を記録したいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please view it without entering inside the exhibit boundary. Would you like to record the part that interests you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 質感を家でも思い出したくて、細部を写真に撮れたらと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作品の質感を思い出すため細部を記録したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to remember the texture at home too, so I was hoping to photograph the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to record details to recall the artwork's texture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この作品の撮影表示を確認します。許可の範囲がわかるまでは、撮らずにお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the photography sign for this work. Could you wait without taking photos until the permitted scope is clear?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 撮影できるとわかってからにします。それまでは冊子の該当ページをメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可を確認するまで撮らず冊子のページ番号をメモする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait until I know photography is allowed. Until then, I'll note the relevant page in the booklet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not photograph until permission is confirmed and note the booklet page number instead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ページ番号なら後で解説を探せますね。撮影の条件は確認後にお伝えします。それでは、まずは境界線の外からゆっくりご鑑賞ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: The page number will help you find the commentary later. I'll explain the photography conditions after checking. For now, please enjoy viewing it from outside the boundary.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はこの列の収穫をお願いします。初めに、担当範囲を指してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please harvest this row today. First, point to your assigned area.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手前の札から奥の青い札まででしょうか。隣の列には入らないという理解で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手前の札から青い札までで隣の列には入らないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: From the near sign to the blue sign at the far end, right? Am I correct that I shouldn't enter the neighboring row?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm the area from the near sign to the blue sign and that the neighboring row is excluded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その範囲です。収穫する状態を実物で見せますので、はさみを持ってこちらへ来てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's the area. I'll show you actual fruit at the right harvesting stage, so please bring your scissors here.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持ち手がぐらついています。昨日の道具と感触が違うので、使う前に見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: はさみの持ち手がぐらつくため使用前に点検を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The handle is loose. It feels different from yesterday's tool, so I'd like you to look before I use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an inspection before use because the scissors' handle is loose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ぐらついたまま使わず、作業台に置いてください。交換品を持ってきますが、その間に自分で締め直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't use them loose; put them on the workbench. I'll bring replacements, but don't tighten them yourself while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台に置いて触らないようにします。交換まで、収穫用の箱を準備してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不具合の道具に触れず収穫箱を準備してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put them down and leave them untouched. May I prepare the harvest boxes until the replacement comes?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave the defective tool untouched and ask whether you may prepare harvest boxes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 準備はできます。空箱は通路をふさがない位置に置き、傷んだ実を入れる箱とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can prepare them. Put empty boxes where they won't block the passage and keep them separate from the damaged-fruit box.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 良い実と傷んだ実の箱を分けます。判断に迷う実があったら、切らずに呼べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を分け、判断に迷う実は切らずに担当者を呼ぶと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll separate the boxes for good and damaged fruit. If I'm unsure about a fruit, should I call you without cutting it?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the boxes and confirm that you will call the responsible person without cutting fruit you are unsure about. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ええ、実物を見て確認しましょう。交換したはさみでの切り方も、最初に一緒に練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, let's check the actual fruit together. We'll practice the cutting method with the replacement scissors together first too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 箱の準備ができたら待ちます。説明を受けてから、一つ目を見てもらって収穫を始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱準備後に待ち、説明と最初の確認を受けてから収穫する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait once the boxes are ready. After the explanation, I'll have you check the first one before starting the harvest.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait after preparing the boxes and start harvesting only after the explanation and first-item check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 自己判断で始めずに待っていてくださいね。交換品を取ってきますので、それでは準備をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait rather than starting on your own judgment. I'll get the replacement, so please prepare the boxes for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子さんの就学についてのご相談でしょうか。現在の状況を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your child's schooling? Please tell me the current situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月、子どもが海外から来る予定です。到着日がまだ決まらなくても、就学の相談はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来月来日予定だが到着日未定でも就学相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is due to come from overseas next month. Can I discuss school enrollment even if the arrival date is not settled yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether school-enrollment advice is available for a child due next month whose arrival date is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず年齢と、現在どの学年で学んでいるかを伺って、担当者への相談方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: First we'll ask the child's age and current school year, then check how to consult the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九歳で、今は現地の小学校の三年生です。日本語はまだ簡単な挨拶しかできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九歳で現地小学校在籍、日本語は挨拶程度と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nine years old, currently in the third year of the local elementary school. In Japanese, my child can only give simple greetings so far.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the age of nine, current local elementary schooling, and greeting-level Japanese. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 学校歴と日本語の状況も伝えておきましょう。相談の際に通訳についての希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's pass on the schooling history and Japanese level too. Do you have any interpretation requests for the consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私も学校の言葉に不安があります。通訳を頼めるかと、予約が必要かを一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通訳の利用可否と予約の必要性を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm also unsure of school-related vocabulary. I'd like to check both whether interpretation is available and whether an appointment is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check interpreter availability and the need for an appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる支援と予約方法を担当に確認します。ご都合のよい曜日や時間帯を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask the person in charge about available support and booking methods. Please tell me suitable days and times.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事の休みは水曜日です。午前なら来られますが、難しければ別の日を調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水曜午前を希望し難しければ別日を調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wednesday is my day off. I can come in the morning, but if that's difficult, I'll arrange another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request Wednesday morning and say you will arrange another day if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 水曜午前を希望として伝えます。日程が決まる際に、持参する書類と来日予定変更時の連絡先も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on your preference for Wednesday morning. When the date is set, let's also check the documents to bring and who to contact if the planned arrival changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約が決まったら書類を用意します。子どもの到着が遅れるときは、その連絡先へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定書類を準備し来日延期時は指定連絡先に知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once the booking is settled, I'll prepare the documents. If my child's arrival is delayed, I'll notify that contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the specified documents and say you will notify the designated contact if arrival is postponed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未確定の予定は未確定と伝えていただいて大丈夫です。それでは、担当からの案内を受け取ってからお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: It's fine to say uncertain plans are still uncertain. Please receive the person in charge's guidance before leaving today.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物ですね。ご予約の便の乗り場は確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: That's a large piece of luggage. Have you confirmed the boarding location for your booked service?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約画面はあるのですが、乗り場がわかりません。階段を使わずに行ける経路も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約画面はあるが乗り場不明で階段を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have the reservation screen, but I don't know the boarding location. I'd also like a route that avoids stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the reservation screen but do not know the boarding location and want to avoid stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面の停留所名と便名を見せていただけますか。似た名称の乗り場と間違えていないか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me the stop name and service name on the screen? Let's check that you haven't confused it with a similarly named boarding point.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この停留所名です。道路の反対側にも看板があったので、どちらか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面の停留所名を示し道路反対側の看板と迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is the stop name. There was also a sign across the road, so I wasn't sure which one.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the stop name on the screen and explain your confusion with the sign across the road. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 進行方向も含めて照合します。階段を避ける場合は、案内図で経路を確認してから移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll compare the travel direction too. To avoid stairs, check the route on the map before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物が重くて持ち上げられません。エレベーターか、段差の少ない道が使えるか調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち上げられずエレベーターや段差の少ない道を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The luggage is heavy and I can't lift it. Could you check whether an elevator or a route with fewer steps is available?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you cannot lift the luggage and want to check an elevator or low-step route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 設備の利用状況を確認します。出発までどのくらい時間がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check whether the facilities are usable. How much time do you have until departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約画面ではあと三十分です。遠回りになるなら、急がず間に合うか先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三十分あり遠回りなら間に合うか先に相談すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The reservation screen says thirty minutes. If it's a detour, I'd like to discuss whether I can make it before rushing off.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have thirty minutes and want to check whether a detour allows enough time first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した経路と移動に必要な時間を踏まえて考えましょう。先に荷物を持って階段へ向かわず、ここでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's consider the confirmed route and travel time needed. Please wait here rather than heading for the stairs with your luggage first.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この場所で待ちます。使える経路がわかってから乗り場へ向かい、便名をもう一度確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機し利用可能な経路を確認後に乗り場と便名を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here. Once I know a usable route, I'll go to the boarding point and check the service name again.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait, confirm an available route, and then check the boarding point and service name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 重い荷物で無理をしないようにしましょう。経路を確認したらお声がけしますので、それまではこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKS-NARUTO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's avoid straining yourself with heavy luggage. I'll call you once I've checked the route, so please wait here until then.
